title.en: Positional encoding: from sinusoidal features to RoPE
title.zh: 位置编码：从正弦特征到 RoPE

en.a: Position mechanisms turn the attention read into a sequence-aware operator, either by rotating Q/K or by biasing the causal score geometry.
en.b: The positional mechanism changes which conditional distribution each query row can represent while the causal factorization remains over the same prefix.

zh.a: 位置机制将注意力读取转换为序列感知算子，通过旋转 Q/K 或偏置因果得分几何结构实现。
zh.b: 位置机制改变了每个查询行可表示的条件分布，而因果分解仍基于相同的前缀。
